title.en-US: The Speed of Light Is More Than a Number

prompt.zh-CN: 在狭义相对论中，真空光速 c 的特殊地位最准确的表述是什么？
prompt.en-US: In special relativity, which statement most accurately describes the special status of the vacuum speed of light c?

text.zh-CN: 它只对光子成立，对其他物体没有意义
text.en-US: It applies only to photons and has no meaning for other objects

text.zh-CN: 所有惯性系测得的真空光速相同，是时空变换的基本不变量
text.en-US: All inertial frames measure the same vacuum light speed, a basic invariant of spacetime transformations

text.zh-CN: 它等于任何物体在任何参考系中的速度
text.en-US: It equals the speed of every object in every reference frame

text.zh-CN: 它只由光源的运动状态决定
text.en-US: It is determined only by the motion of the light source

reveal.zh-CN: 光速不变性与相对性原理共同构成狭义相对论的出发点，并不只是一个记号记忆题。
reveal.en-US: Light-speed invariance together with the principle of relativity is a starting point of special relativity, not merely a notation question.

title.en-US: Is Gravitational Acceleration Always the Same?

prompt.zh-CN: 忽略空气阻力，在同一地点把两个质量不同的物体从同一高度同时静止释放，哪项正确？
prompt.en-US: Ignoring air resistance, two objects of different mass are released from rest at the same height and location. Which statement is correct?

text.zh-CN: 重的先落地，因为重力更大
text.en-US: The heavier one lands first because gravity is larger

text.zh-CN: 两者加速度相同，均近似为 g
text.en-US: They have the same acceleration, approximately g

text.zh-CN: 轻的先落地，因为惯性更小
text.en-US: The lighter one lands first because its inertia is smaller

reveal.zh-CN: 重力和惯性质量都与质量成正比，因此近地自由落体加速度与物体质量无关。
reveal.en-US: Both gravitational and inertial mass scale with mass, so near-Earth free-fall acceleration is independent of the object's mass.

prompt.zh-CN: 一个电阻保持不变，电路两端电势差加倍时，稳恒直流电流如何变化？
prompt.en-US: If the potential difference across a fixed resistor is doubled, how does the steady DC current change?

reveal.zh-CN: 在线性欧姆元件中 I=V/R，电阻不变时电流与电势差成正比。
reveal.en-US: For a linear ohmic element, I=V/R, so current is proportional to potential difference when resistance is fixed.

prompt.zh-CN: 牛顿第一定律也常被称为什么定律？
prompt.en-US: Newton's first law is also commonly called which law?

reveal.zh-CN: 答案是惯性定律。物体不是懒，只是在坚持运动状态。
reveal.en-US: The answer is the law of inertia. Objects are not lazy; they are maintaining their state of motion.

prompt.zh-CN: 放射性同位素的“半衰期”描述的是什么？
prompt.en-US: What does the half-life of a radioactive isotope describe?

text.en-US: The time for mass to double from nowhere

text.zh-CN: 样品中一半原子核衰变所需时间

The time for speed to halve

reveal.zh-CN: 答案是一半原子核衰变所需时间。它不是生命值条，但名字很像。
reveal.en-US: The answer is the time for half the nuclei to decay. It is not a health bar, though it sounds like one.

prompt.zh-CN: 在通常的经典磁场图示中，磁力线不能相交的直接理由是什么？
prompt.en-US: In a usual classical magnetic-field diagram, what is the direct reason magnetic field lines cannot cross?

text.zh-CN: 磁场线本身是实体导线
同一点的磁场方向只能唯一确定
text.en-US: The magnetic-field direction at one point must be unique
A magnet has only one pole

reveal.zh-CN: 磁力线是表示矢量场方向的辅助曲线，同一点不可能同时有两个不同的磁场方向。
reveal.en-US: Field lines are auxiliary curves representing a vector field; one point cannot have two different field directions at once.
